entries.message: This update includes sync up next and watched state across providers and prevent stale media renders and harden sync performance.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tweak: This update includes sync up next and watched state across providers and prevent stale media renders and harden sync performance.

Tweak: Keep Up Next and watched state aligned across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin, repair newly available provider episodes, preserve accurate progress, restore episode titles, and polish refresh/menu controls.
Tweak: Prevent stale media detail responses from repainting the dashboard after rapid navigation.
Tweak: Keep show and movie detail hydration, watch actions, and provider-derived state consistent during asynchronous loads.
Tweak: Improve scheduler, live-session, and incremental provider-sync behavior for reliable updates.
Tweak: Bound and instrument derived-cache rebuilds and add repeatable large-library performance baselines.
Tweak: Harden response caching, compression, and asset-version handling for safer browser loads.
